name: Valorant Tracker
author: PackRat
short_description: Track Valorant rank, RR, session progress, recent competitive stats and match controls directly on Stream Deck.
description: Turn Stream Deck into a physical Valorant ranked dashboard. See your current rank and RR, session RR, wins and losses, last match, headshot percentage, top agents, maps, ACS and recent competitive results without leaving the game. A built in 45 second spike timer and manual win and loss controls make the dashboard useful while you play. Setup is shared across every action: enter your Riot ID, region and your own HenrikDev API key once in the Property Inspector. Includes editable dashboard profiles for Standard, XL and Neo.
features: Session RR and win loss tracking
Recent competitive headshot percentage, ACS and damage
Top agents with K/D and win rate
Recent match actions for expanded dashboards
Manual win and loss logging with later API reconciliation
One shared account setup across all actions
Five minute shared cache to reduce HenrikDev API usage
Last known good data during temporary API or network failures
Bundled Standard, XL and Neo dashboard profiles
Windows and macOS builds validated in CI
setup: Install Valorant Tracker and add an action or open a bundled dashboard.
Enter your Riot ID in Name#TAG format.
Choose NA, EU, AP, KR, LATAM or BR.
Open the HenrikDev dashboard, generate an API key and paste it once.
Optionally set an act end date for the Act Countdown action.
backend_disclosure: HenrikDev is an independent third party community API. Availability, endpoint behavior and rate limits are controlled by HenrikDev rather than PackRat.
privacy: Riot ID, region, HenrikDev API key, session state and cache are stored locally using Stream Deck settings. Player requests are sent to HenrikDev only. PackRat does not receive the API key or player data and the plugin has no PackRat analytics endpoint.
disclaimer: Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Riot Games or HenrikDev.
